<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>TROGÜI TV Stick | Convierte y actualiza tu TV en Smart TV</title>
<meta name="description" content="TV Stick Android 4K de TROGÜI. Envío gratis a toda Colombia. Pago contra entrega.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,600;9..144,700;9..144,800&family=Work+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --white:#FFFFFF; --gray:#F4F4F2; --ink:#121315; --ink-soft:#4A4E52;
    --clay:#FF5722; --clay-dark:#D93A0F; --gold:#FFB300;
    --green:#16A34A; --green-light:#E8F7EE; --line:rgba(18,19,21,0.10);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{margin:0; background:var(--white); color:var(--ink); font-family:'Work Sans', sans-serif; line-height:1.5; overflow-x:hidden;}
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Fraunces', serif; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.01em; margin:0; color:var(--ink);}
  img{max-width:100%; display:block; height:auto;}
  a{color:inherit;}
  .wrap{max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 20px;}
  .bg-alt{background:var(--gray);}

  .topstrip{background:var(--ink); color:var(--white); font-size:12.5px; letter-spacing:.03em; text-align:center; padding:9px 12px;}
  .topstrip b{color:var(--clay);}

  header{position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50; background:var(--white); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .headerbar{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:12px 20px; gap:10px;}
  .logo img{height:30px; width:auto; border-radius:6px;}
  .wa-btn{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:var(--green); color:var(--white); padding:10px 14px; border-radius:100px; font-weight:700; font-size:13px; text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap;}
  .wa-btn svg{width:15px; height:15px; fill:var(--white);}

  /* ===== HERO ===== */
  .hero{padding:28px 0 0;}
  .hero-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:0;}
  .hero-media img{width:100%; aspect-ratio:4/3; object-fit:cover;}
  .hero-copy{padding:26px 20px 30px; text-align:center;}
  .eyebrow{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; background:var(--gray); color:var(--ink); padding:6px 13px; border-radius:100px; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.02em; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:12px;}
  .hero h1{font-size:25px; line-height:1.18;}
  .hero h1 em{font-style:normal; color:var(--clay);}
  .hero p.lead{font-size:14.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:10px auto 0; max-width:46ch;}
  .price-row{display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:12px; justify-content:center; margin:18px 0 16px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .price-now{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:34px; font-weight:800; color:var(--clay);}
  .price-old{font-size:15px; color:#9AA0A6; text-decoration:line-through;}

  .cta-primary{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; background:var(--clay); color:var(--white); font-weight:800; font-size:16px; padding:16px 26px; border-radius:12px; border:none; cursor:pointer; width:100%; max-width:420px; box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(255,87,34,0.32); text-decoration:none; animation:shakeCTA 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @keyframes shakeCTA{0%,88%,100%{transform:translateX(0) rotate(0);}89%{transform:translateX(-3px) rotate(-1deg);}90%{transform:translateX(3px) rotate(1deg);}91%{transform:translateX(-3px) rotate(-1deg);}92%{transform:translateX(3px) rotate(1deg);}93%{transform:translateX(-2px) rotate(0);}94%{transform:translateX(0);}}
  .shipband{background:var(--ink); color:var(--white); padding:11px 0; overflow:hidden; position:relative;}
  .shipband-track{display:flex; gap:40px; white-space:nowrap; animation:scrollBand 16s linear infinite; font-weight:700; font-size:12.5px; letter-spacing:.03em; width:max-content;}
  .shipband-track span{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; color:var(--gold);}
  @keyframes scrollBand{0%{transform:translateX(0);}100%{transform:translateX(-50%);}}
  .cta-primary:hover{background:var(--clay-dark);}
  .cta-sub{font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:10px;}

  .trust-row{display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:20px;}
  .trust-chip{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:var(--green-light); color:var(--green); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:100px;}

  @media(min-width:860px){
    .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; align-items:center; gap:40px;}
    .hero-media img{aspect-ratio:4/5; border-radius:18px; box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(18,19,21,0.14);}
    .hero-copy{text-align:left; padding:0;}
    .hero h1{font-size:38px;}
    .hero p.lead{margin:12px 0 0;}
    .price-row{justify-content:flex-start;}
    .trust-row{justify-content:flex-start;}
  }

  section{padding:44px 0;}
  .section-title{text-align:center; max-width:640px; margin:0 auto 30px;}
  .section-title .eyebrow{margin-bottom:12px;}
  .section-title h2{font-size:24px;}
  .section-title p{color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:10px; font-size:14.5px;}

  /* ===== Problema -> Solución ===== */
  .ba-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:16px; max-width:760px; margin:0 auto;}
  @media(min-width:640px){.ba-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
  .ba-card{border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line);}
  .ba-label{padding:10px 16px; font-weight:800; font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase;}
  .ba-before .ba-label{background:var(--ink); color:var(--white);}
  .ba-after .ba-label{background:var(--clay); color:var(--white);}
  .ba-tv-mock{background:#1B1C1E; aspect-ratio:4/3; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:#6b6f73; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; text-align:center; padding:20px;}
  .ba-after img{aspect-ratio:4/3; object-fit:cover;}
  .ba-note{text-align:center; font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:14px;}

  /* ===== Video (placeholder honesto) ===== */
  .video-placeholder{max-width:420px; margin:0 auto; aspect-ratio:9/16; background:var(--gray); border:1px dashed var(--line); border-radius:20px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; padding:24px; text-align:center;}
  .video-placeholder .play-icon{width:56px; height:56px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--clay); color:var(--white); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:22px;}
  .video-placeholder p{font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:0; max-width:26ch;}

  /* ===== Beneficios ===== */
  .feat-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:16px;}
  @media(min-width:640px){.feat-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
  @media(min-width:900px){.feat-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}}
  .feat-card{padding:22px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:16px; background:var(--white);}
  .feat-icon{width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--ink); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; margin-bottom:12px; color:var(--white); font-size:18px;}
  .feat-card h3{font-size:15.5px; margin-bottom:6px;}
  .feat-card p{font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:0;}

  /* ===== Cómo funciona ===== */
  .steps-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:18px;}
  @media(min-width:760px){.steps-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;}}
  .step-card{text-align:center; padding:10px;}
  .step-num{width:46px; height:46px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--clay); color:var(--white); font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-weight:800; font-size:18px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; margin:0 auto 14px;}
  .step-card h3{font-size:16px; margin-bottom:6px;}
  .step-card p{font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:0;}

  /* ===== Oferta ===== */
  .offer-band{background:var(--ink); color:var(--white); border-radius:20px; padding:32px 24px; text-align:center;}
  .offer-band .eyebrow{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color:var(--gold);}
  .offer-band h2{color:var(--white); font-size:24px; margin-bottom:14px;}
  .offer-price{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:38px; font-weight:800; color:var(--clay); margin-bottom:6px;}
  .offer-band p{color:#C7CACD; font-size:13.5px; margin-bottom:20px;}

  .kit-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:12px;}
  @media(min-width:520px){.kit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
  .kit-grid img{border-radius:14px; border:1px solid var(--line);}
  .includes{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:30px; align-items:center;}
  @media(min-width:860px){.includes{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:44px;}}
  .includes-list{list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0;}
  .includes-list li{display:flex; gap:12px; padding:10px 0; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line); font-size:14.5px;}
  .includes-list li:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .check{color:var(--green); font-weight:800;}

  .specs{background:var(--white); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:16px; padding:6px 20px;}
  .spec-row{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; padding:13px 0; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line); font-size:14px;}
  .spec-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .spec-row b{color:var(--ink);}
  .spec-row span:last-child{color:var(--ink-soft); text-align:right;}
  .specs-note{font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-align:center; margin-top:14px; max-width:500px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;}

  .trust-img{max-width:520px; margin:0 auto; border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden;}
  .badges-row{display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; margin-top:26px;}
  .pill{background:var(--white); border:1px solid var(--line); padding:8px 14px; border-radius:100px; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700;}

  .reviews-note{max-width:640px; margin:0 auto 26px; background:#FFF7E8; border:1px solid var(--gold); color:#7A5A17; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; padding:12px 16px; border-radius:12px; text-align:center;}
  .review-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:16px;}
  @media(min-width:700px){.review-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
  @media(min-width:1000px){.review-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}}
  .review-card{background:var(--white); border:1px dashed var(--line); border-radius:16px; padding:20px;}
  .review-stars{color:var(--gold); font-size:14px; margin-bottom:10px;}
  .review-card p{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:0 0 14px; font-style:italic;}
  .review-who{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;}
  .review-avatar{width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--gray); color:var(--ink-soft); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-weight:800; font-size:13px;}
  .review-who b{font-size:13px; display:block;}
  .review-who span{font-size:12px; color:#9AA0A6;}

  .order{background:var(--white); border-radius:22px; border:1px solid var(--line); padding:24px;}
  .order-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:26px;}
  @media(min-width:860px){.order{padding:36px;} .order-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:40px;}}
  .order h2{font-size:22px; margin-bottom:8px;}
  .order p.sub{color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:13.5px; margin-bottom:20px;}
  .form-row{margin-bottom:14px;}
  .form-row label{display:block; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:6px;}
  .form-row input, .form-row select{width:100%; padding:12px 13px; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); font-family:'Work Sans',sans-serif; font-size:15px; background:var(--gray);}
  .form-row input:focus, .form-row select:focus{outline:2px solid var(--clay); outline-offset:1px;}
  .addr-toggle{display:flex; gap:8px; margin-bottom:16px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .addr-opt{flex:1 1 130px; text-align:center; padding:11px 8px; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; background:var(--gray);}
  .addr-opt.active{background:var(--green-light); border-color:var(--green); color:var(--green);}
  .qty-row{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; margin-bottom:18px;}
  .qty-btn{width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--gray); font-size:18px; cursor:pointer;}
  .totalbar{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; padding:14px 16px; background:var(--gray); border-radius:12px; margin-bottom:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px;}
  .totalbar b{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:19px; color:var(--clay);}
  .order-side{background:var(--gray); border-radius:16px; padding:20px;}
  .order-side h3{font-size:15px; margin-bottom:12px;}
  .order-side ul{margin:0 0 16px; padding-left:18px; font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .order-side ul li{margin-bottom:8px;}

  .faq-item{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding:15px 0;}
  .faq-q{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; cursor:pointer; font-weight:700; font-size:14.5px; gap:12px;}
  .faq-a{max-height:0; overflow:hidden; transition:max-height .3s ease; font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .faq-item.open .faq-a{max-height:220px; padding-top:10px;}
  .faq-plus{font-size:19px; transition:transform .3s; flex-shrink:0;}
  .faq-item.open .faq-plus{transform:rotate(45deg);}

  .final-cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ink) 0%, #23262A 100%); color:var(--white); text-align:center; border-radius:0;}
  .final-cta h2{color:var(--white); font-size:26px; margin-bottom:18px;}
  .final-cta .cta-primary{margin:0 auto;}

  footer{background:var(--white); color:var(--ink-soft); padding:30px 0; font-size:12.5px; border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .foot-grid{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:14px; align-items:center;}
  .foot-logo img{height:24px; border-radius:5px;}

  .sticky-cta{position:fixed; bottom:0; left:0; right:0; z-index:60; background:var(--ink); padding:10px 14px; display:none; box-shadow:0 -8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);}
  .sticky-cta-inner{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; max-width:520px; margin:0 auto;}
  .sticky-price{color:var(--white); font-weight:800; font-size:15px;}
  .sticky-cta a{background:var(--clay); color:var(--white); font-weight:800; padding:11px 18px; border-radius:10px; text-decoration:none; font-size:13.5px; white-space:nowrap;}
  @media(max-width:700px){.sticky-cta{display:block;} body{padding-bottom:66px;}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="topstrip">🚚 <b>Envío gratis</b> a toda Colombia · 💵 Pagas cuando lo recibes en tu casa</div>

    <span>✅ Producto nuevo y garantizado</span>
    <span>🚚 Envío gratis a toda Colombia</span>
    <span>💵 Pago contra entrega</span>
    <span>✅ Producto nuevo y garantizado</span>
    <span>🚚 Envío gratis a toda Colombia</span>
    <span>💵 Pago contra entrega</span>
    <span>✅ Producto nuevo y garantizado</span>
  </div>

<section>

<section class="bg-alt">

Disfruta tus contenidos favoritos desde tu TV. CANLES COMO WIN, WIN SPORT Y MÁS TOTALMENTE GRATIS ✅(AHORRA DINERO)</h2>

<section>

<section class="bg-alt">
  <div class="wrap">

<script>
  function setDelivery(type){
    document.getElementById('opt-domicilio').classList.toggle('active', type==='domicilio');
    document.getElementById('opt-oficina').classList.toggle('active', type==='oficina');
  }
  let qty = 1; const unitPrice = 89000;
  function changeQty(delta){
    qty = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, qty + delta));
    document.getElementById('qtyDisplay').textContent = qty + (qty===1 ? ' unidad' : ' unidades');
    document.getElementById('totalPrice').textContent = '$' + (qty*unitPrice).toLocaleString('es-CO');
  }
  function toggleFaq(el){ el.parentElement.classList.toggle('open'); }
</script>
